services.name: Starr Parkour
services.desc: Parkour is what all the kids are talking about these days! It's the sport that got us so excited we even changed our name! It's a fusion of movement, jumps, climbing, swinging rolling and twisting. It's about moving through the environment in different ways, using a variety of dynamic equipment to leap from place to place. If your athlete is literally jumping off the walls and can't stop moving - this is the program that will get them hooked! Parkour at Starr will teach the fundamentals of vaulting, tricking, wall and bar skills and ninja stunts. We have a fully redesigned A to Z curriculum to teach all kinds of tricks that are safe, fun and just all around awesome! REGISTRATION is Ongoing
